Plot functional recovery metric summaries with source point or IQR geometry

etr_plot_functional_recovery_summary.Rd

Return source-scientific Matplotlib artist coordinates from already computed native R scientific results, with original base R plotting and numerical return preserved by default.

Usage

etr_plot_functional_recovery_summary(summary, metric, statistic = "median",
  strict_source_record = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

summary

A native source-shaped recovery summary data frame, corresponding to Python's summary pandas DataFrame.

metric

Exact recovery statistic metric identifier in the summary.

statistic

Selected summary column; median uses existing q25 and q75 for an IQR when present, while other statistics are displayed as points only.

strict_source_record

Return a typed R source scientific artist record instead of the original numeric geometry when TRUE.

...

Additional legacy R graphics options.

Value

Default invisible native recovered group numeric geometry. Strict mode yields median IQR asymmetric error bars (caps 3) when available or point-only estimates otherwise, source scenario/source/component labels, 45-degree tick labels and original title and axis text.

Details

Frozen source eyetrajectoriespy 1.2.0. Strict source records do not recreate a live Python matplotlib.axes.Axes object, all Python dataclass or pandas acceptance/exception protocols, backend raster parity, or independent full-contract certification.
